_note: W26-04, ruling W26-R5. The roofing service page's product sections. FIVE groups replace the seven catalogue subcategories the filter bar was built from; `from_catalog` says where each old subcategory lands, and the eight redirect pages under /catalog/materiale-acoperis/ keep answering and now aim at the group their subcategory went into. `products` are the imperlux.md models W26-R5 puts first. Each one either FOLDS dasterum.md records in as grades, in which case the card carries the cheaper grade's price and its picture and the folded records are the variants, or it folds none and renders Pret la cerere against a slot of its own that is still empty. NOT TAKEN from imperlux.md: every image (W24-R2), the description sentence under each name, which is marketing rather than a product fact (W25-25's precedent), the struck price, the percent badge (W26-R5, R-X) and THE WARRANTY, which W26-R6 holds until the owner confirms the roof warranty rows. A dasterum.md record whose model name is absent from imperlux.md stays a card of its own and is listed in `dasterum_only`. The third source of build.js's Russian colour dictionary, after the fence palette and the metal tile legend: the bare colour words the imperlux model cards and the Novatik page print in Romanian and neither file carries. imperlux.md publishes no Russian page, so these Russian names are authored here the way the fence palette's are (garduri-modele.json, _colour_note); a colour name translated is not a claim. Matched on the exact Romanian word, case-insensitively. The RAL each word stands for on imperlux's own product page is recorded beside it, from the page's colour picker (Bavaria: RAL 7016 Gri Antracit, RAL 8017 Maro Ciocolata, RAL 8019 Maro, RAL 9005 Negru), so a later reader can check the word against the code.
